import json, subprocess, sys

def get_all(kind):
    rows = []
    page = 1
    seen_pages = 0
    while True:
        out = subprocess.run(["python3","api.py",kind,"--page",str(page)],capture_output=True,text=True)
        if out.returncode != 0:
            print("ERR",kind,page,out.stderr,out.stdout); sys.exit(1)
        d = json.loads(out.stdout)
        rows.extend(d["data"])
        seen_pages += 1
        np_ = d.get("next_page")
        if np_ is None:
            break
        page += 1
        # safety
        if page > (d.get("total_pages") or 0)+1:
            print("too many"); sys.exit(1)
    return rows, seen_pages

orders, op = get_all("orders")
refunds, rp = get_all("refunds")
json.dump(orders, open("orders_all.json","w"))
json.dump(refunds, open("refunds_all.json","w"))
print("orders:",len(orders),"pages",op)
print("refunds:",len(refunds),"pages",rp)
EOF
python3 fetch.py", "description": "Fetch all pages via API CLI"}
